documents.title: Audited financial statements
documents.text:
Audited financial statements — Elmbrook Group (fictional).
In this document "EGH" means Elmbrook Group. Elmbrook Group reports capex of $10.3m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Elmbrook Group reports available liquidity of $19600k for FY2024 on a reported basis. Elmbrook Group reports revenue of $599.396m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Elmbrook Group reports EBITDA of $42m for FY2025 on a reported basis under the original agreement.

documents.title: Lender presentation
documents.text:
Lender presentation — Elmbrook Group (fictional).
Elmbrook Group reports capex of $9m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Elmbrook Group reports available liquidity of $19.6m for FY2024 on a reported basis. Elmbrook Group reports customer concentration of 22.4% for FY2024. EGH reports cash margin of 4.8% for FY2025.

documents.title: Compliance certificate
documents.text:
Compliance certificate — Elmbrook Group (fictional).
Elmbrook Group reports revenue of $598.2m for FY2025 on a reported basis. Elmbrook Group reports EBITDA of $34.7m for FY2025 on a reported basis under the amendment no. 1 (supersedes). Elmbrook Logistics subsidiary reports customer concentration of 27.6% for FY2024. Elmbrook Group reports cash margin of 4% for FY2025.
